meta.title: The H₂ effervescent tablet — composition & absorption | RevolutTIME
meta.description: What's inside the Magnesium + H₂ tablet, how fast it dissolves and absorbs, an honest comparison with pharmacy magnesium forms, and how it feels to take it.

tablets.title: The H₂ effervescent tablet
tablets.subtitle: What it's made of, how it absorbs, how it differs from pharmacy magnesium forms — and what people who drink it daily feel.

composition.title: Composition
composition.subtitle: A short formula with nothing extra — everything on the label, everything clear.

absorption.title: Absorption
absorption.subtitle: The tablet works in three beats — from the fizz to the last sip.

dissolve.title: Dissolving
dissolve.text: Fully dissolved in 1–1.5 minutes in 150–200 ml of cold water. Cold water holds more H₂.

peak.title: Concentration peak
peak.text: The highest level of dissolved hydrogen comes at 3–4 minutes: up to 1.6 ppm according to the Eurofins analysis.

drinkNow.title: Drink it fresh
drinkNow.text: H₂ is light and escapes quickly — the drink is consumed fresh, which is exactly how you get the maximum.

comparison.title: Compared to pharmacy magnesium forms
comparison.subtitle: The magnesium form defines absorption. Our tablet combines the magnesium source with the reaction that creates H₂.

oxide.title: Magnesium oxide
oxide.text: The cheapest pharmacy form with low bioavailability — often accompanied by GI discomfort.

citrate.title: Magnesium citrate
citrate.text: A well-absorbed form. In our tablet, the same citric acid binds the magnesium in solution.

ours.title: Magnesium + H₂
ours.text: Magnesium + citric and malic acids: when dissolved, it forms magnesium citrate/malate in drinkable form plus molecular hydrogen.

feel.title: How it feels
feel.subtitle: What people who drink hydrogen water regularly report*.
items: Lightness and freshness instead of “heavy” water — many describe the drink as mildly sparkling, with no acidity or metallic taste.
Smooth energy through the day* — without the sharp ups and downs of caffeine.
A pleasant recovery feel after workouts* — magnesium works on muscles and the nervous system, hydrogen on the quick sense of recovery.

cta.title: Try it yourself
cta.text: Packs of 90 and 120 tablets — delivered from Bavaria in 1–2 days.

footnotes.title: Notes (*)
items: How it feels after taking it is the subjective experience of users and practice observations, not medical claims. The product is not intended to diagnose, treat or prevent any disease.

The magnesium-form comparison is provided for informational purposes based on public bioavailability data and is not advertising of medicinal products — the wording has been checked against HWG requirements.

usage.title: How to use
usage.subtitle: Three simple steps — and your H₂ water is ready.

step1.title: Dissolve
step1.text: Add one tablet to 150–200 ml of still (non-carbonated) water. Cool water at 10–12 °C keeps the hydrogen best.

step2.title: Wait
step2.text: The tablet dissolves in 1–1.5 minutes. Maximum H₂ concentration is reached at 3–4 minutes.

step3.title: Drink
step3.text: Drink right after it dissolves. Recommended: 3–4 glasses a day for tone and metabolism.
